content_of_post_to_answer: Is there any cure for loneliness?
answer: Loneliness doesn't always mean being alone; sometimes it means being around people who never really see you. The cure depends on which kind you're experiencing: lack of company, lack of belonging, or lack of emotional connection. Each requires something different. I've explored this distinction further in other writing on my Quora profile, if you'd like to read more. The goal isn't to eliminate solitude, but to stop feeling invisible in your own life.
